Duration: 6 months contract (extension option) 

 MEAN: MongoDB, Express, AngularJS, NodeJS  

 The company, a well-established entertainment company, is looking for a MEAN developer, who will help in developing a custom application for program scheduling. The said application will be used by management to make scheduling decisions for the company based on advertising dollars, viewership, etc. 
 
 

 

 • Java developer experience 
 • Expert in building distributed real-time single page application that have leveraged socket.io (web sockets) on top of a caching layer (I.e.: Kafka or Redis) 

 • Testing Driven Development (TDD) Champion - Mocha, Karma, lint, istanbul 

 • Agile Expert 

 • Experience in DevOps/Automation using git/jenkins/npm/bower/gulp/grunt 

 • Experience in designing and implementing distributed micro service architecture 

 • Experience in designing and implementing Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)
